protocol_budget_note: Full unredacted session audit trail per IR-CTHG-BUDGET-01 and Parallel-Run Protocol Rule 6. All intermediate engineering/bugfix iterations and fail-closed uniqueness stops are logged openly alongside the canonical 3-experiment ablation ladder.

shared_bugfixes_before_final_ladder.description: During initial OOF cache generation (v1, interrupted during cell 8 at 1,800s timeout before any evaluation), line-by-line review of docs/repo-review-2026-10-28.md showed bhgc_extra_6ch.npy ch 1 (Band 6 radiometric TC misread as magnetic tilt) also flowed transitively into bhgc ch 5 (0.14 weight) and cshd ch 7 (0.13 weight). Patched src/gems32/bhgc.py in place (schema_version=2, Band 2 RTP + Band 9/Band 3 TMI tilt), rebuilt bhgc_extra_6ch.npy, cshd_extra_8ch.npy, wchd_extra_8ch.npy, 104-ch leakage canary (passed=True, max AUC 0.587571), and all 24 v2 OOF caches cleanly.

Two post-evaluation serialization bugs in scripts/run_wchd_pipeline.py were fixed before clean completion: (1) line 718 KeyError on bundle['audit_json_path'] (5bdd79c6, HR=0.10041, Det=0.08920, SGMC_cal=0.06432, Step B=0.6858; orphan files deleted); (2) line 887 KeyError on c_row['name'] vs release_gate.compare_registry key c_row['registry'] (68a6a27f, HR=0.10191, Det=0.09026, SGMC_cal=0.06550, Step B=0.6925; orphan files deleted).

An intermediate carrier variant applying mtn_core_damp (damping depth < 35 m & slope > 14 deg) forced P_blind onto the same piedmont aprons as CSHD (37b32d5b), reaching 0.702422 (> 0.70) 3-px dot overlap against 37b32d5b at Step B (HR=0.10952, Det=0.09448, SGMC_cal=0.05993). Automated Step B halted immediately with exit_code=1 before writing any GeoTIFF. Restoring the pure WCHD potential-field/Morris/magnetite-destruction/updip carrier without mtn_core_damp at d_min=3.88 reduced 37b32d5b overlap to 0.682823 (<= 0.70, PASS across all 942 unique rasters).
